lucee.notes: Despite the name, this is a server level configuration

name: RestInitApplication
description: Registers the directory path with the service mapping provided.
syntax: RestInitApplication( string dirPath, [string serviceMapping], [boolean default], [string password] )

params.name: dirPath
params.description:
Path to the directory to be registered or reset.

This folder should contain 

- one or more REST enabled CFCs, i.e. with `rest=true`
- An `Application.cfc` (if required)

params.name: serviceMapping
params.description: Alternate string to be used for application name while calling the REST service.

params.name: default
params.description: set if the mapping is a default mapping or not

params.name: password
params.description: password for the web administrator, this is needed when you update/create a REST mapping.
